verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents its own export features: filtered transactions can be exported to CSV through its MCP server, and every Instant Pay transaction exports with reference ID, timestamp, and on-chain hash. APIs also expose cards, payments, transactions, and expense data. These exports cover transaction data only, not a full account export, and nothing documents leaving the platform. Missing for 10: a documented complete export of all account data (receipts, memos, users, cards, vendors), confirmation of open-format bulk export beyond transaction CSV, account closure or offboarding docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
